description: This file defines and exports multiple API endpoint functions for authentication, health checks, submissions, validation, audit, and evidence, using imported utility functions for request handling and context building.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs in a user via POST /api/v1/auth/login

methods.name: me
methods.description: Fetches current user profile via GET /api/v1/auth/me

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Approves or rejects a submission via POST /api/v1/submissions/{id}/approve

methods.name: approveCompat
methods.description: Simplified approval endpoint for compat mode

methods.name: queryEvents
methods.description: Queries audit events via GET /api/v1/audit/events with optional filters

calls: apiRequest(`/api/v1/submissions/${encodeURIComponent(submissionId)}/validate`, { method: "POST", json: { validation_profile: validation_profile || "baseline", audit_context: buildAuditContext(currentUser) } })

apiRequest(`/api/v1/submissions/${encodeURIComponent(submissionId)}/approve`, { method: "POST", json: { decision, rationale: rationale || null, password: password || null, audit_context: buildAuditContext(currentUser), signature: buildSignatureBlock(currentUser, signature_reason || "Approval action") } })
